name: TROLL SQUID GAME TOWER
desc:
🦑 Welcome to TROLL SQUID GAME TOWER! 🦑
Climb a troll tower with traps, fake paths, and the Squid Game doll watching you!

🚦 Red Light Green Light with the doll!  
🪢 Jump Rope from Squid Game Season 3!  
🪙 Get coins and power-ups at the top!  
🖐 Push, slap, and troll other players!  
🔓 Unlock Squid Game and Troll Tower skins!

👍 Like & ⭐️ join the group for rewards!
